content: <p>Bird launched micromobility. Now we’re shaping its future.</p> <p>We’re Bird, and we’re on a mission to <strong>transform the way the world moves one ride at a time</strong>. Our products, services, and people share one common goal: to make cities more livable by empowering people and communities everywhere to <strong>move freely, discover new possibilities, and create a cleaner, more connected future.</strong> To cleaner air. To calmer streets. To cities built for people.</p> <p><strong>Who We Are</strong></p> <p>Bird is a global leader in micromobility, dedicated to shaping the future of urban movement. Our cleaner, affordable, and on-demand mobility solutions are available in over 200 cities worldwide.</p> <p>We take a collaborative, community-first approach to micromobility. Bird partners closely with the cities in which it operates, leveraging our experience and safety-first technology to help them meet their <strong>shared mobility and climate goals</strong> and provide a reliable, affordable, and responsible transportation option for people who live and work there.</p> <p>Our award-winning electric vehicles have empowered more than <strong>eighty-seven million rides </strong>in cities around the world and helped riders take carbon-free trips in more than 200 cities globally. And our teams are constantly pushing boundaries and challenging the status quo in pursuit of a brighter future.</p> <p><strong>Job Summary</strong></p> <p>The Operations Partner is a critical logistical role essential to Bird's success in Vaughan, ON. You will take responsibility for the logistics of the local fleet of e-scooters and e-bikes, ensuring they are charged, safe, and positioned correctly to meet the community's transportation needs.</p> <p>We are looking for entrepreneurial individuals or logistics businesses ready to hit the ground running.
